reports.title: MBX Biosciences Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Corporate Highlights

desk.headline: Clinical-stage: net loss widens to $62.4m on Phase 3 start and a one-off share-award charge; $481.6m cash funds operations into 2029
results: No revenue. Net loss grew to $62.4m ($1.29 a share) from $21.6m ($0.63) a year earlier.
R&D rose 66% to $32.0m, mainly start-up costs for the Phase 3 trial of canvuparatide (hypoparathyroidism) and the MBX 4291 obesity study.
G&A jumped to $34.3m from $4.7m, including a $20.8m share-based charge from changing the former CEO's awards.
Cash and investments rose to $481.6m, helped by $97.6m net from selling shares through its at-the-market programme.
The pivotal Phase 3 oPTimize trial dosed its first patient in August and plans to enroll about 160 adults.

guidance.summary: No financial guidance, as usual for a clinical-stage biotech. Cash is expected to fund operations into 2029, and 12-week data for obesity drug MBX 4291 remain on track for Q4 2026.

watch: 12-week MBX 4291 obesity data due in Q4 2026, especially weight loss and stomach side effects with once-monthly dosing.
Enrollment progress in the Phase 3 oPTimize trial of once-weekly canvuparatide.
Development-candidate picks and IND-enabling progress for MBX 5765 and MBX 6180.
